item.title: Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding So Far
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to our podcast, where we dive into the latest celebrity news and updates. Today, we're talking about the highly anticipated wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce. The couple announced their engagement back in August 2025 with a simple Instagram post, and since then, they've been making headlines left and right."
[Soft music transitions]
Host: "Taylor Swift has been busy, releasing her 15th Billboard 200 No. 1 album, The Life of a Showgirl, which broke records by moving 4 million equivalent album units in its first week. Meanwhile, Travis Kelce signed on for his 14th season with the Kansas City Chiefs."
[Short pause]
Host: "As for the wedding planning, it's been a tight-lipped affair. Donna Kelce, Travis's mom, refused to comment on her involvement when asked by a photographer at LAX, simply saying she's 'happy' for the couple. And Kylie Kelce, Travis's sister-in-law, even went on her podcast to plea with fans to stop asking her for wedding details, jokingly saying she has 'none' to share."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But despite the secrecy, we do know that the wedding took place on July 3rd at the iconic Madison Square Garden. And while we don't have all the details just yet, we'll be keeping a close eye on this celebrity couple and bringing you updates as more information becomes available."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this episode. We'll be back with more celebrity news and updates soon. Don't forget to subscribe to our podcast for the latest scoop."
